## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: /dso:review-stats --source=central dispatches query-stats.sh and surfaces output

Depends on: query-stats.sh task

## Implementation Notes
Edit plugins/dso/skills/review-stats/SKILL.md to accept --source=central; dispatches plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh and surfaces stdout. Default (no --source) preserves existing behavior.

Add integration test extending tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh (or sibling) — stubs query-stats.sh emitting sentinel; asserts sentinel reaches caller via --source=central; default routing does NOT call query-stats.sh.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] SKILL.md documents --source=central
  Verify: grep -q 'source=central' plugins/dso/skills/review-stats/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md references query-stats.sh path
  Verify: grep -q 'plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh' plugins/dso/skills/review-stats/SKILL.md
- [ ] Integration test passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
